metadata.question: Within a 100 km radius of (-1.593993, -49.053062) in the Amazon Rainforest, on August 19, 2009, is there a greater presence of cloud cover over land areas compared to river areas?

data.raw_code: The question is about comparing cloud cover over land vs. river areas within a 100 km radius of (-1.593993, -49.053062) in the Amazon Rainforest on August 19, 2009. 1. Search strategy: - Date: August 19, 2009 (single date) - Location: 100 km radius circle around point (-1.593993, -49.053062) - Data: Need cloud cover information. MODIS products (MOD09GA or MOD35_L2) have cloud masks and were available in 2009. - Land/Water separation: Use a water mask dataset (JRC Global Surface Water or MOD44W for 2009). 2. Masking strategy: - Need to extract cloud mask from MODIS - Separate land vs. river areas using water mask 3. Logic: - Get MODIS image for the date - Extract cloud mask (cloudy vs. clear) - Apply water mask to separate pixels - Calculate cloud fraction for land and water areas - Compare: if land_cloud_fraction > water_cloud_fraction → Yes (A), else No (B) - Handle edge cases: no data (C1), no valid pixels (C2), calculation failure (C3) Key considerations: - MOD09GA (Terra) has daily surface reflectance with cloud state band (available since 2000) - Use 'state_1km' band for cloud information (bits 0-1: 0=not determined, 1=clear, 2=cloudy) - Water mask: JRC Global Surface Water has data from 1984-2020, use occurrence layer - Need to check for data availability and valid pixels Approach: 1. Define geometry (100 km radius circle) 2. Get MOD09GA image for 2009-08-19 3. If no image, try MODIS Aqua (MYD09GA) as fallback 4. Extract cloud mask: cloudy = bits 0-1 == 2 (binary 10) 5. Get water mask from JRC (occurrence > 90 for permanent water) 6. Calculate: - Cloud fraction over land = cloudy pixels on land / total land pixels - Cloud fraction over water = cloudy pixels on water / total water pixels 7. Validate results and output answer Edge cases: - If no MODIS image: try Landsat 5? But cloud products less reliable. Better to use MODIS. - If 0 valid pixels after masking: C2 - If result NaN/None: C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-49.053062, -1.593993]); const region = point.buffer(100000); // 100 km radius const date = '2009-08-19'; const startDate = ee.Date(date); const endDate = startDate.advance(1, 'day'); // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Terra (MOD09GA) for cloud information let modisCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD09GA') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(region); // Check if collection is empty let colSize = modisCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS Terra images: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { // Try MODIS Aqua as fallback modisCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD09GA') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(region); colSize = modisCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS Aqua images: ${colSize}`); } if (colSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get the image const image = modisCol.first(); // 3. Extract cloud mask from 'state_1km' band (bits 0-1: 00=not determined, 01=clear, 10=cloudy) const cloudMask = image.select('state_1km') .bitwiseAnd(3) // Get bits 0-1 .eq(2); // 2 (binary 10) = cloudy // 4. Water mask from JRC Global Surface Water (1984-2020) const waterMask = ee.Image('JRC/GSW1_0/GlobalSurfaceWater') .select('occurrence') .gt(90); // Permanent water (occurrence > 90%) // Land mask is inverse of water mask const landMask = waterMask.not(); // 5. Calculate cloud fractions // Cloudy pixels over land const cloudLand = cloudMask.updateMask(landMask); const landStats = cloudLand.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }); // Cloudy pixels over water const cloudWater = cloudMask.updateMask(waterMask); const waterStats = cloudWater.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }); // Get values const landSum = landStats.get('state_1km').getInfo(); const landCount = landStats.get('state_1km_count').getInfo(); const waterSum = waterStats.get('state_1km').getInfo(); const waterCount = waterStats.get('state_1km_count').getInfo(); console.log(`Land: ${landCount} pixels, ${landSum} cloudy`); console.log(`Water: ${waterCount} pixels, ${waterSum} cloudy`); // 6. Check for valid pixels if (landCount === 0 || waterCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Calculate cloud fractions const landCloudFraction = landSum / landCount; const waterCloudFraction = waterSum / waterCount; console.log(`Land cloud fraction: ${landCloudFraction.toFixed(3)}`); console.log(`Water cloud fraction: ${waterCloudFraction.toFixed(3)}`); // 7. Validate and determine answer if (landCloudFraction === null || waterCloudFraction === null || isNaN(landCloudFraction) || isNaN(waterCloudFraction)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Check if land cloud fraction > water cloud fraction if (landCloudFraction > waterCloudFraction) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
